data.budget: read-only, about 90 minutes, no repo edits
data.claim: ddflow already records approver, forced override, gates, sha and outcome-ish links for code changes, but has no structured risk class, rollback plan, impact record, change calendar, revert helper or config.changed history; a derived change view over existing events can cover most of a change record without a new tracker.
data.falsifier: Build the derived view for the last 50 completed items: if more than 20 percent lack approver, scope, evidence or outcome that cannot be joined from existing events, the view needs new events and the minimal-subset claim fails.
data.mechanism: All ingredients of a change record already live in separate events (item.completed.approval/forced/overridden/ledger/sha, ask.requested/answered/consumed, gate.*, ci.result, bug.found.item, decision.recorded/superseded, worktree.merged); the gap is a join plus four missing fields (risk class, rollback plan, window, outcome link) and one missing event family (config.changed, task P-configurable.event, open).
data.probe: python over main .ddflow/events/*.jsonl 2026-09-28..2026-11-03 (70436 non-heartbeat events); ddflow list task/phase/research; grep of ddflow/ and docs/ for change calendar, freeze, rollback plan, risk_glob; git log revert/main-red counts; WebFetch of dora.dev, NIST CSRC, GitHub docs, Claude Code docs, Anthropic auto-mode post, Codex docs, ServiceNow docs, SLSA, Argo Rollouts, OPA, Keep a Changelog, K8s KEP process
data.probe_output: Window 36 days (not 60). 1565 non-imported completions, 259 forced (16.5%), 150 forced with approval record, 109 forced before approval gating (no record). 346 asks: complete.force 210, gate.skip.failed_review 111, claim.force 22, approve.partial 2, chore.approve 1; 312 answered, all approved, 0 denied; 278 person (156 harness credential L2, 122 terminal L1), 34 policy (complete_unavailable 27, claim_unavailable 5, baseline_red_auto 2). config.set events 0, config.changed events 0 (26 git commits to .ddflow/config.toml, one author). gate.skipped 1167 (none carry an approval id). decisions 471, superseded 55. bug.reopened 2, item.reworked 4, abandoned 196 (21 after merge, mostly bookkeeping), unique revert subjects in git 8, commits titled main red 12, ci.result failed 149 of 1378. bugs with item and filed after merge: 54, median 0.29 h. Structured risk, impact or rollback field: none; free-text mentions in task/decision/bug records: risk 143, impact 32, rollback 23 of 5909. CM- prefix already used by 24 commit-message tasks; XP-* and MR-* not filed.
data.question: What does ddflow already record about changes (code, workflow/config, plan, emergency), where are the gaps against ITIL 4 change enablement, DORA and agent-approval practice, and what minimal derived change view plus phase closes them?
